description: Student-founder of a 3-person side project, curious about voice AI, no timeline.

transcript.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant running a short qualification chat for the Voice AI Readiness Assessment. It takes about three minutes. What are you looking to build or improve with voice AI?
Nothing specific yet, I'm just curious and learning how voice agents work.
Exploring and learning, great. Roughly how many people are at your company?
It's just me and two friends, so three.
A team of three, got it. When are you hoping to have something live?
No real timeline, just exploring for now.
No rush, understood. What are you using today: building in-house, another provider, or starting from zero?
Starting from zero, haven't built anything.
Starting fresh. And what is your role on the team?
I'm a developer, I write the code.
